findings.steps: Viewport 1096x800 (1152): Rotation tab > expand Rotation map > Timeline (or set Timeline on the card first and expand). Also 1384x900: set Timeline on the card, then expand.
findings.expected: As the user's target (58.png) and CHANGES item 9: legend at the bottom of the window, Timeline using the window.
findings.actual: 1152/1280: window 752 px tall, legend ends 181 px above the window's bottom (empty white band below it where the hidden readings/How-to-read were), 108 px blank between the date row and the legend. 1440 opened with Timeline on the card: window 820 px, 293 px blank between grid and legend (opened by switching inside the window at 1440 it is fine: legend 1 px from bottom, 85 px blank).

findings.title: Stock momentum quadrant: outlier dots still touch/overprint quadrant names and labels at narrow widths, and one outlier still squeezes the chart
findings.where: Rotation > Health stock momentum quadrant card, 1152 dark and 360 light (also window)

findings.title: Beta window: right-aligned numbers of the lower table sit 4-5 px right of the upper table's although the column edges match
